rows.summary: Declare the Node branch and derive the graph from Formal Claims
id_reference_lines: This proposal covers governing Drafts for the Node branch, graph Relations and notation, Role/Form naming, carrier mappings and formal Scope. It records the latest human decisions; earlier conflicting alternatives are superseded. The [Epic successor Draft](../../../../../03_plan/draft/CA-P-2694@39-draft-EPIC--entity-graph-refactor-stage-4-polishing.md) tracks adoption and implementation dependencies.

- **Derive Primary Node versus Property.** The Node branch permits zero or one IS_PROPERTY_OF bearer. Zero derives Primary Node and no direct value; one derives Property and forbids narrowing and instantiation. Property-bearing must be acyclic. HAS_VALUE binds a Property on an instance to a literal, such as CA-P-123.version = 1; literals do not become declared graph Nodes.
